prediction_question: Will a major Taiwan reservoir's effective storage ratio fall below a drought threshold (e.g. 20-30%) within the next 30 days, conditioned on it being above the threshold now (onset formulation)?
prediction_time: Daily at the 07:00 observation instant (the dataset states 水位、有效蓄水量及蓄水百分比 are the current day's 07:00 values), using only snapshots up to that instant.
target_definition: Binary onset: storage percentage (蓄水百分比) of reservoir R crosses below the threshold on some day within (t, t+30] while above it at t. Label source column is the same series' future values; excluded from features by the window construction.

sources.notes: current-day snapshot only; fields documented: accumulaterainfallincatchment, inflowdischarge, waterlevel, effectivewaterstoragecapacity, statustype, etc.; note 3 on the dataset page: historical data must be queried at the fhyv2 disaster-info site

measurements.fhy_api_probes_2026_10_22: fhyv2 SPA network capture (browser): API family https://fhy.wra.gov.tw/Api/v2/... (Rainfall/Station, Event/Year/{y}, Event/Active, Basic/City) plus /disaster/Reservoir/Comparison.
measurements.fhy_api_status_2026_10_22: Plain-client GET of https://fhy.wra.gov.tw/Api/v2/Event/Year/2025 and /Api/v2/Event/Active -> HTTP 401 (91 bytes each); /disaster/Reservoir/Comparison -> 4,252-byte AngularJS HTML shell, not JSON.
measurements.opendata_wra_unreachable_2026_10_22: opendata.wra.gov.tw unreachable from the coordinator: SSL certificate fails strict verification (same Missing Subject Key Identifier failure as dgpa.gov.tw) and DNS resolution for the host failed intermittently; the Swagger UI could not be read from either client.
measurements.no_history_conclusion_2026_10_22: No anonymously retrievable historical daily storage series found: data.gov.tw 45501/41568 publish current-day snapshots only (45501 '更新頻率 每1時', resources CSV/JSON/XML).

rejection_reason: Parked on access/history, not licence and not task: a drought-onset task needs ~10+ years of daily storage, and no anonymous historical bulk source exists. data.gov.tw 45501/41568 publish only current-day snapshots; the publisher routes history queries to the fhyv2 interactive viewer, whose JSON APIs answer 401 to plain clients and whose comparison view is an Angular page; the WRA opendata Swagger is unreachable from this host (SSL chain fails strict verification, DNS intermittent). Without history, splits cannot be computed; the only route is collecting daily snapshots over months, which is a standing collector, not a discovery probe.
next_action: Unpark only if (a) the routine seeds a standing snapshot collector (fetch 45501/41568 daily, one row per major reservoir, into the private staging; splits become usable after ~2-3 typhoon/drought cycles), or (b) an authenticated WRA opendata endpoint with history is found and the operator provisions a credential. The task itself is well-posed and licences clean (ODDL 1.0).
